tei:div.tei:p: lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang ma bu'i dkad chag shel dkar me long bzhugs so/rgyalamachogalngabachenaposabartsams/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /

par thengs gsum pa'i gsal bshad/lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag 'di ni rgyal mchog lngapa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog gis spyi lo 1645 lor mdzad gnang ba yin zhing / 'di'i nang lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid bzhengs bskrun byung ba'i lo dus dang / nang rten sku gsung thugs rten byin can rnams bzhengs byon ji ltar byung tshul/ de rnams kyi zungs rten ngo mtshar mchog tu gyur pa ji ltar phul ba sogs kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel phyis gtsug lag khang 'dir nyams gso zhu skabs kyi sbyin bdag zhu mkhan sogs 'khod pa'i lo rgyus dkar chag cig yin/deng gi char rgyal khab phyi nang nas yul skor spro 'cham du phebs mkhan spyi dang / lhag par bod ljongs 'di'i lo rgyus rig gnas la rtog zhib dang zhib 'jug gnang mkhan/ gzhan yang gangs ljongs kyi dad ldan skye bo kun la gtsug lag khang 'di'i lo rgyus mtshams sbyor legs btus su mkho 'don yong ba'i dge mtshan la gzhigs te da lam dmigs bkar du par 'grems thengs gsum zhus pa yin/ da res par 'grems gsum pa zhu ba'i skabs dang bstun nas 'di nang gi yig nor mngon gsal che ba rnams dag bcos zhus pa phud/ bye brag nang tshan la'ang dkar chag lam tsam zhig gsar snon zhu khul bgyis yod/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur bas/

dkar chagasngona'agro'i gtam/ /1/dngapo/ gtsugalagakhabadangasartenabazhengasatshul/ (7/gcig gtsug lag khang bzhengs tshul/ (7/gnyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi sku rten bzhengs tshul/ /10/1 byang ngos gtsang khang sbug gi sku rten bzhengs tshul/ /11/2 gtsang khang mdo'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ /13/3 byams pa khrus mdzad ma'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ (14/4 byams khang mdo'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ (15/5 rje'i gtso 'khor sku rten bzhengs tshul/ (15)6 bu ston rin po che'i gtso 'khor sku rten bzhengs tshul/ (16/7 shar ngos gtsang khang byang ma'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ (18/8 gtsang khang mdo'i sku rten bzhings tshul/ (18/9 shar ngos gtsang khang dbus ma'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ (19/10 gtsang khang mdo'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ (25/11 shar ngos gtsang khang lho ma'i sku rtenabazhengs tshulda/ 1 35/

12 gtsang khang mdo'i sku rtenabazhengs tshul/ /yo/13 sto ngos gtsang khang gi sku rten bzhengs tshul/ /27/14 gtsang khang mdo'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ ཿ/15 bar khang nub kyi gtsang khang dbus ma'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ ༅/16 pe dbar sbrug gi sku rten bzhengs tshul/ /31/17 gser thog 'og gi sku rten bzhengs tshul/ /32/18 ka ba shing lo can sogs kyi byung tshul/ /33/gnyisapa/ gtsugalagakhanganyamasagasomadzadatshug mo/gsumapa/ gtsugalagakhabamachodapa'i phanapon/ /43/bzhi pa/ jo bornamaganyisakyi byungatshulamadotsamabarjodapa/ /45/lngapa/ zhar byungalcagasapori dngapota ryā skos /49/gcig lcags po ri'i sku rten/ /49/gnyis/ po ta la'i sku rten/ /༅/drugapa/ mjugabaspu'igatag /ma/

sngon 'gro'i gtam/stobs bcu'i lang tsho dar ba'i mdzes sdug gis//bgrang yas chos kun ri dwags mig can yid/'gugs par byed pa'i rnam 'dren sgyu rtsal spyod//zas gtsangawas kyis legs pa'i dpal kun stsol//lus can kun la ris su ma chad brtse chen lho phyogs lam las longasapa'i dri bzhon gyis/mtha' yas brjod bral gsang ba gsum gyi ma la ya yi ljon pa bskyod las gangs can 'dir/sa dbang dam pa'isna 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar dri bsung tshar du dngar bas yongs gang ba/khrims gnyis drang por srong la btsan zhing sgam pa'i dbang phyug 'khor losasnar ba rgyal gyur cig/rgyalabakun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'chi med tshogs kyi lam yangs por/sna tshogagasku yi bkod pa'i zlos gar rlung gi rgyal mtshan rab bkra ba'i/mkhan slob chosakhargyal mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan phyogs kyi lus phra'i mgrin pa las/ 1

nam yang zad pa med par len de skye dgu'i bsod nams zong gi dpyid/zur phud lnga pa'i mtshan dpe'i rang snang mtho ris bdag po'i lding khang nas//thub pa'i bstan la rjes su chags pa'i rin chen sbrel ba'i them skas las//bde bar legs babs mi yi snang brnyan 'gro la ston pa'i gar mkhan mchog/mi ṭwādī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃji bzang po'i grags 'bar tsong kha pa la spyi bka' khrims char gyis phan bde'i 'khri shing kun//g.yur du za bas rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron//'gugs mkhas phag mo gru pa'i sde srid ces//gnam bskos rgyal po'i lugs srol de rmad byung /phyag na padmas 'dul zhing kha ba'i ljongs/mchog dman kun gyi bsod nams bskrun pa'i yul/lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bzang gi//dkar chag deb ther bsgrig la su mi spro//ngo mtshar chos 'byung dpyid kyi dpal mo las/lo rgyus legs bshad dbyar skyes gzhon nu'i mgron//2 khungs ldan gtam gyi ljon shing ldem pa'i rtser//

nyams 'gyur snyan tshig me tog rab bkra 'di/zang zing 'byor pa'i bya rgod 'dab gshog la/nyer bstan mkhas mang gnyis skyes gral bsnyeg pa'i//bstan 'dzin pha wang tshogs kyi yul min kyang kudapyod ldan khu byug snying la lhag par 'jebs/chu 'dzin stug po'i dbus na 'brug gi sgra//dal bur sgrogs tshe rma bya gar byed na/lo rgyus tshul la gdung ba'i skye bo'i tshogs//nor 'dzin gser gyis bka' las cis mi dga'/mi dman dge ba'i tshogs kyi dkar phyogs la//bsod nams cha shas yongs su ches gang ba'i/chos ldan rgyal po'i chu shel dbang po yi//'dzad bzang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di na spro//nor rdzas 'od chung tsam gyis cher dregs pa'i/blun rmongs srin bu'i me yi ngang tshul dag/ring spangs ya rabs ngang tshul nyin byed la//rab dga'i padma sgra 'dzin 'dab rgya phye/dri bza'i 'phang 'gros char yang bsgrun min zhing //shes ldan mkhas mang dga' byed rna ba'i rgyan1dkar chag gdong lnga'i rgyud kyi nga ro'i dbyangs//mdzad med mgrin pa'i lam nas deng 'dir len// 3

zhes shis pa brjod pa'i glu dbyangs kyis sdun bsus te/ mtha' klas pa'i lus can kun la ris su chad pa med par phan pa dang bde ba'i lam bzang po la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bkri ba'i brtse chen thugs rje'i dbang phyug rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa rin po che ni lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi legs byas rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub la/ de nyid 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa sa chen po byams pas skyong ba'i chos ldan gyi rgyal po zhig la rag las pa'i phyir/ rang cag rnams kyi ston pa'i bstan pa bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di nyid du 'byung ba'i thabs su/ 'phagasapa rigs gsum gyi mgon po bod rgyal po'i rnam par bstan pa'i rje rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi bar du byung ba'i gnam gyi khri bdun/ stod kyi steng gnyis/ bar du legs drug sa la lde brgyad/'og gi btsan gsum du grags pa'i rgyal po rnamasakyang / dngos su chos kyi khrims bca' ba ma byung yang / mtha' 'khob gdul dka'i skye bo rnams thabs du ma'i sgo nagabatul te/ brgyud nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel ba'i bdag rkyen sha stag mdzad la/ khyad par lha tho tho ri gnyan btsanagyis dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas gdung rabs lnga song ba'i tshe/ phyag na padma'i ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po 'jigs pa med pa'i khri chen po la zhabs zung gi padmo rnam par bkod de rgyal ba'i sras po 'gro la rjes su chakās pa'i snying stobs dang / dpa' zhing rtul phod pa/ gzhan gyis

tshad gzung dang bral ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa'i snyan grags kyi rnga bo che 'dzam gling yangs pa'i sa'i khyon thams cad du khyab pas/ rgya dkar nag stag gzig ge sar sogs rgyal po chen po rnams kyis gus pas btud cing nor gyi dpya phul/ chos blon thon mi sam sto ṭa rgya gar du brdzangs te rgya gar gyi yi ge las btus nas bod la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge sum cu so bzhi gtan la phab/ chos dge ba bcu las brtsams pa'i bka' khrims btsan pos mchog dman yongs kyi gnya' bar gser gyi gnya' shing lta bur lci/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu las sprul pa'i dge slong blo gros 'byung gnas tshul khrims pho nyar mngags te yi dam gyi lha rangacun rnam pa gnyis spyan drangs/ rgya bal gyi rgyal po dregs pa can rnams kyang phyi nang gsang ba gsum la brten pa'i thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul dngablon po mgar rig pa can sogs kyi byed pos nga rgyal gyi gdong pa bsnyil/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa'i btsun mo gnyis dang de dag gi rten skal du kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i sku'i snang brnyanamathong thos dran reg tsam gyis mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa zad mi shes pa skrun par byed pa zung sogs rten ngo mtshar can du ma dang klu'i dbang po'i bang mdzod kyi khengs pa 'dzoms par nus pa'i bdog pa'i skyes mtha' yas pa drangs te/ bod kyi rgyal khams thams cad chos dang srid kyi 'byor pa ma smad pa dbyar gyi chu bo bzhin du 'phyur bar gyur/ de yang gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i lte ba/gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa padma 'dab brgyad dang / ṭwāṃng

nyang bran bal po che'i ri la dbu la gdugs/ mal grong gi ri la spyan la nya(ka khol mar dog sde ra ga brag zer // mdong mkhar gyi brag la ljags la padma/ nyang bran phan dkar gyi ri la gsung la dung (la la grib kyi 'khyags pa dkar chung la zer // rdzong btsan gyi ri la mgul la bum pa/yug ma'i ri la thugs la dpal be'u/ka khol mar gdugs ni byang shar ngos na yod par bshad // da lta rmog lcog tu grags pa'i brag ri la sku lus rgyal mtshan/ stod lung brang phu'i ri la phyag zhabs 'khor lo ste logs bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs sa dpyad ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan gyis khor yug kun nas dkrigs pa'i dbus su shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bskrun pas lus can mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par ji ltar nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i mun pa sel ba de srid du spel bar mdzad pa yin no/

dang po/ gtsug lag khang dang sku rten bzhengs tshul/gcig gtsug lag khang bzhengasatshul/bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi rdzing bu la//mtho ris bdun gyi yon tan ngang mo dkar//bde skyid glu dbyangs rkang gdub 'khrol bzhin du/ngo mtshar 'phur lding zlos gar ci yang bsgyur/'khor los mtshan pa'i kun gsal lus phra ma/pad 'dab nor 'dzin gzhon nur chags pa'i bzhin/bkra shis rtags kyi zur mig g.yo ba yis/chos srid dge mtshan mtha' dag ngang gis 'gugs//gdul dka'i 'gro la byams brtses rjes chags pa'i//rgyal sras rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur pa'i dpal//'dzin mkhas srong btsan sgam po'i sgyu dra'i gar/sgyur tshe dregs ldan kun kyang 'phyang mo nyug/mtha' 'khob ba glang ltar blun skye bo'i tshogs/blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros gsal ba yis//lcags zong gser 'gyur rtsi yi sbrul bsgyur la/ 7

mtshar du 'dzin pa'i snang ba dag gdong bskyungs/bod 'bangs skye dgu'i grangs med legs byas kun//sa 'dzin dbang por co 'dri'i phung po'i ljid//ma bzod dbyig 'dzin ngal ba'i jul gyi rgyun//babs la dza hu'i bu mor btags sam snyam//legs byin ma dang khro gnyer can ma zung //rgya bal sa dbang sras mor sku sprul nas/srong btsan btsun mo'i zol gyis phan bde yi/gzhir gyur gtsug lag khang bzang brtsig pa la//nag po'i yid kyis mngon brlams lha srin dpung /nyer 'tshe'i glags blta mtho 'tsham sbyor ba kun//bzhom pa'i rnam mang thabs kyi mdzad pa yis/bgegs med 'gro ba'i gnyen du 'grub de mtshar/ /zhes pa ste bal bza' khri btsun gyis/ rgya mo bza' la gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i g.yul dang sadapyad gang bzang 'dri bar bran mo zhig btang bas/ rgya nag gi spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi steng nas legs nyes kyi tshul gsal bar gtan la phab kyang / bran mos 'phrin thams cad ma 'byor bar brten/ mtsho bsub pa'i sbyor ba byas na'ang cha tsam du yang ma bsubs pas/ rgya mo bzas phrag dog gi rnam pas tshul bzhin ma byas par mngon nas/ rgyalapo la yang ma zhus par/ la gdong ne'u thang la rma~X bting ba mtshan mo mi ma yin gyis shul tsam yang med par bshig

pas/ rgyu mtshan rnams rgyal po'i snyan du gsol ba na/ chos rgyal gyis mkhyen bzhin du ma mkhyen pa ltar mdzad nas khri btsun dang bcas 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram du phebs te/ sor gdub mkha' la bskyur bcug pas mtsho nang du babs pa dang / mtshe'u'i dbus na 'od zer sna tshogs las grub pa'i mchod rten 'dug pa rje blon kun gyis gzigs te/ chos rgyal gyis bden tshig dang / blon 'bangs kyis rdo bskyur ba lhan cig tu 'dzoms pa'i mthus/ rdo'i mchod rten bsra zhing brtan pa zhig tu song ba la gdung ma rnams kyi sne gtad de dka' tshegs med par mtsho bsubs/'on kyang rgya bza'i rtsis khog nas byung ba'i bcos ka rnams ma 'grub pa'i stabs kyis gtsug lag khang brtsigs kyang lha 'dres bshig pa na/ kong cos rtsis khog nas legs nyes kyi blang dor bstan tshul rgyal po'i snyan du byung bas/ shin tu dgyes te/ chos rgyal yab yum gsum gyis skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar/ bsra ba'i mkhar dgu thog brtsigs pa'i nang du zhag bdun gyi ring sgrub pa mdzad pas/ rigs gsum mgon pos zhal gzigs/ byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi/ yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi/ ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi rnams bzhengs/ gzhan yang sa dpyad ngan pa mtha' dag bcos rjes/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang /rgyalapo nyid kyis sku lus kyi bkod pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang / bod 'bangs las la bskul ba sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad pa bstan te bgegs med par grub pa dang chabs cig par ༵ mo

che'i gtsug lag khang yang lhun gyis grub bo//gnyis/ sku gsung thugasakyi sku rten bzhengasatshul/de ltar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan kun//gcig tu 'khyil ba'i gtsug lag khang gi rten//bris 'bur byung tshul sri zhur bgyis pa rnams/'khrul pa med par gleng ba brjod bya dngos//seng ldeng sgo mo nas brgyud chos skor du//sku gsung thugs rten lo chen rin bzang sogs//dam pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur spel ba'i phreng //mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu ltar rnam par bkra/ / zhes pa ste sku'i rten du ldebs bris la rgyal ba rigs lnga chos rgyal nyid kyi phyag nas ma/gsungagi rten du thugs rje chen po'i gzungs yi ge drug ma chos rgyal gyi dus/ thugs kyi rten du sa paṇa gyis bzhengs pa'i brtag pa mchod rten chos rgyal gyi phyag tshwa bzhugs pa/ gzhis ka sne'u pas bzhengs pa'i lo chen rin chen bzang po/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ mnga' ris pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/g.ya' phug pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rje btsun mi la ras pa/zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa rnams dang / da lta mahwa ka lar grakā~X pa zhig po bdud rtsi/ de'i steng thub pa'i sku/ mdol chung skor

dpon/ gtsang khang byang ma'i sgo steng du skyid shod sde pa bkra shis rab brtan gyis bzhengs pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku 'dra dang / rigs gsum mgon po rnams bzhugs so//1 byang ngos gtsangakhang sbyag gi sku rten bzhengs tshul/nag phyogs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs brag gi ri//'joms la rang byung sku brnyan gnam lcags thog/'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor skal ldan gyi//mig gi bdud rtsir gtsang khang byang 'dir bzhugs/ / zhes pa ste thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal 'di ni/ gtsug lang khang brtsig pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba'i thabs yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/rgyal po rang gi sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sku gzugs shig bzhengs na 'dod pa'i don 'grub bo zhes pa'i sgra zhig byung ba la brten nas/ sngar sprul pa'i dge slong gis spyan drangs pa'i byang chub shing gi yal ga rgya mtsho'i gling gi 'jag ma/ chu bo nee rañdza'i bye ma/tsan dan sbrul gyi snying dang / gor shi sha'i dum bu/ gnas chen brgyad kyi sa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i rdzas mang po gcig tu brdar nas ba dmar dang ra dkar gyi 'o ma blugs te sbrus pa'i phung po rgyal po'i dbu sngas su bzhag cing / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la 1༵la

ba btab pas/ bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs nam mkha'i khyon gang ba lta bu 'jim pa'i phung po de la thim pa gzigs/ nangs par sngar gyi rgyu rnams la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal du grub 'dug pas/ rgyal pos bal po'i bzo bo la/ rten 'di ya mtshan zhing shin tu mgyogs pa zhig byung 'dug na'ang / rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i tsan dan gyi rang byung dang / sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi ring bsrel rnams nang bzhugs kyi tshul du gzhug rgyu yin pa la gsungs par/ bzo bos/ sku 'di bdag gis bzhengs pa ma lags/ rang byon du gda'o/ zhus ma thag tu/ zhabs g.yon pa'i sham thabs pus mo'i gong du brdzes/ zhabs mthil las 'od zer byung bas rten de rnams drangs te thugs kur thim zhing / de yang nub phyogs zla ba tshal gyi dug shing sdong po rkang gcig gi rtsa na lha srin rnams 'tshogs te/ chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'dun ma shoms pa la/ thugs rje chen po bzhad pa'i zhal las 'od zer gnyis byung bas/ gcig gi sne la khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba byung nas ma mo'i nyal sa phrogs te rdo rje'i ra bas bskor bar byin gyis brlabs/gcig gi sne la rta mgrin byung ba'i zhal nas me dpung thog ltar song bas lha 'dre rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu bskrad par mdzad pa'i sku brnyan 'di nyid la nang bzhugs 'phags pa'i sku rang byon dang / chos rgyal yab yum gsum thim pas rang byon lnga ldan zhes grags pa yin/'khor du chos rgyal nyid kyi dus su bzhengs pa g.yas phyogs su 'jig rten dadi~X phyug khro gnyer can/ dbyangs can ma/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/

g.yon phyogs su kha sarla ni/ sgrol ma/ 'od zer can/ rta mgrin rnams bzhengs shing / khang par bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang rta mgrin gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la bar du gcod pa'i nag po'i 'desrin mtha' dag btul bas byin rlabs shin tu che/ rta mgrin gyi zhabasagayas pa'i 'og nas grub thob dngos grub dang / mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis thugs rje chen po'i chos skor bton pas cung zad yo ba la blun po rnams mdzo mo 'dzam gling rgyan gyi lo rgyus blos byas zer ro/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'jam dbyangs dang phyag rdor gnyis tshal pa khri dpon gyis bzhengs/ de yang gtso 'khor dgu po po ta la nas skyes bu'i rtsol ba la ma ltos par gtsang khang byang ma 'dir rang byon du phebs pa yin no//lha gtsangakhang mdo'iskurten bzhengs tshul/rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes bzung thang stong pas/rabs bzhengs mkhas dang grub pa'i gzugs kyi sku/yasatshan bkod pa'i rim pa 'di ltar ro/ / zhes pa ste de nas phyir 'ongs pa na/ gtsang khang phyi'i khyams na rim pa bzhin gter ston thang stong rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i nyid kyi sku dang / dam pa sangs rgyas/ grubathob binapa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sgo khang stedī ṭwāṃs

gsum sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs so//3 byams pa khrus mdzad ma'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/rnam mang thos pa'i sras 'grub sgra bsgyur rjes//chos rgyal sku khrus gsol ba'i nyal 'gro yis/gsher ba'i rdul mang phung po las bskrun pa'i//mi pham mgon po mchog de'i sku'i snang brnyan/ /zhes pa ste chos rgyal yab yum rnams sku khrus mdzad pa'i chu rgyun gyis yongs su brlan pa'i sa la sku rgyu'i gtso bor mdzad nas zangs mkhar lo tsā ba zhes 'phags pa'i yul nas gangs can ljongs 'dir dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i skad gnyis smra ba des rje btsun byams mgon gyi sku bzhengs par byams pa khrus mdzad du grags shing sku pang na mgo yod lha khang nas spyan drangs pa'i tsan dan las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs/ mnyam med jo bo chen po'i bla ma gser gling pa'i thugs dam rten li dkar gyi tshe dpag med/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ dkon gnyer dpon rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long rtsom pa po legs pa'i shes rab kyi gdung rten/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku/ bshan pa me ru rtse'i sdig bshags la bzhengs pa'i 'bum/ mnga' ris pa brtson 'grus snying po'i gdung rten/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i dus kyi rdo kong bkra shis 'od 'bar rnams bzhugs so/14

4 byamasakhang mdo'isku rten bzhengs tshul/bod yul bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhan slob zung /lta ngan 'joms byed ka ma la shī la'i/sku gzugs rig 'dzin padma'i gdung 'dzin pa'i/theg mchog rgya mtsho'i gling pa de yis so/ / zhes pa ste phyi'i khyams na rim pa bzhin du/ chos rgyal yab yum sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus rdo padma spungs pa/ gter ston padma gling pas bzhengs pa'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho/ dus gsum mkhyen pa padma sam bha wa/mkhas pa'i dbang po ka ma la shī la gsum dang / ne chung ri pas bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba sman pa'i rgyal po rnams bzhugs so/5 rje'i gtso 'khoraskurten bzhengs tshul/rgyal ba'i yab gcig zur phud lnga pa yis//rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum phung po dang //rgyal sras yon tan ma lus gcig bsdus nas/rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i skur bstan tshe/dge legs beeḍūr mthing kha zhu ba'i khams/dge mtshan yul gru'i snod du 'khyil ba yis/dge ba'i dngos po mtha' dag dar ro zhes/ 15

dge zhing shis pa'i dbyangs 'di srid rtser bsgrags/'jam dpal snying po'i blo yi pha mtha'i tshad/tshad mas gzhal nus min na gser gyi mngal/mngal bzang sngon med sbrum la 'jigs pa'i tshul/tshul bzhin phyogs bral skye bo'i ngag las thos/rnam 'dren ma lus lus pa med pa'i tog /rgyal ba'i sras kun kun nas 'dud pa'i yul/blo bzang grags snyan snyan pa'i gdugs dkar can/'dren pa mchog de de phyir skye dgu'i gnyen/ / zhes pa ste lcagasakhra'i nang du/ dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i sku 'dra rin po che rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag nas ma 'drenakhyed kyi yul du gyur pa tsam gyis kyang byang grol gyi sa bon mtha' yas pa 'jog nus pa de'i g.yon du sa skya'i gdung brgyud ta ming gan gyi ti shrī theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis bzhugs/6 bu ston rin po che'i gtso 'khor 7rten bzhengs tshul/'jig rten dbang phyug las brgyud tsand+ra pa/'jig rten mes po'i sras kyi cha bsags mdo/'jig rten kun la mngon par ston mdzad pa'ispyo16 'jig rten mig gcig sgra bsgyur lo tsā bas/

rmongs pa mkhas pa'i go sar 'gying min pa'i/grags pa don dang mthun pa'i paṇḍi ta/bu ston chos rje sogs kyi sku brnyan rnams/'dren byed yul gyi bdud rtsi'i tshar du dngar// zhes pa ste lo chen byang chub rtse mos bzhengs pa'i kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ sa skya'i gdung brgyud gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsang chen slob bshad kyi bdag po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gzhan yang / mu sras pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/rje drung kurma rang byung rdo rje rnams bzhugs/nag po'i yid kyis nyer bskyod glang dar mas/phan bde'i rtsa lag bstan la rma 'byin tshe/rten gsum 'jig pa'i byed po'i tshogs rnams la/'jigs rung cho 'phrul ston pa'igasang ba'i bdag /ces pa ste/chos rgyal gyis phyag nas 'thor zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i sku 'di nyid/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs te/ gtsug lag khang 'jig pa'i thog ma lha sa la byas nas/ phyi nang gi rten gsum rnams med par gtong rtsis kyis thog mar phyag rdor gyi mgul la thag pa btags pas/ 'dogs mkhan khrag skyugs pa dang / spyo 'bog sogs kyis shi ba'i mthus/ gtsug lag khang gi 'jig 'phro bcad pas khyad par du 'phags so/17

7 shar ngos gtsang khang byang ma'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/phyag na padmas gangs can rgyal po'i tshul/rab 'dzin gang des shākya'i pho brang mchog/bzhengs la byin rlabs phung po 'di'o zhes//ston phyir 'ja' tshon dra bas rnam par sbrel/mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/mtha' dag 'od phung gyur la ro gcig kyang //'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad ces grags pa'i/nang tshan snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor mdzes/ zhes pa ste/gtsang khang nang gi gtso bo 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas/ 'khor spyan ras gzigs/ sa'i snying po/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ nam mkha'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po 'jam dbyangs/ phyag na rdo rje/ byams pa rnams chos rgyal dus so//8 gtsang khang mdo'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/rgya nag dmag tshogs bzlog nus dpung chen po/gang gi lto bar gnas pa'i khyon yangs 'di/shong ba'i snod du pha mtha' yas pa'i sa//18 'jig rten mes pos ched du bskrun par nges/

'jam mgon mi yi rang gzugs khri srong rjes//zan yang mi 'gyur lhun grub gtsug lag khang //bzhengs pa'i phud las rgyal chen rnam bzhi'i sku//dpa' gtum khro chags nyams 'gyur ci yang ston//zhes pa ste gtsang khang nas phyir 'ongs pa'i khyams na/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha khro bo rme ba brtsegs pa/ blon po mgar gyis rgya yul du g.yo sgyu khram gsum byas par brten/ chos rgyal mya ngan las 'das pa'i gtam rgya yul du thos ma thag rgya dmag 'bum phrag bcu bod du lhags pa'i 'jig skrag gis sus kyang ma thub pa'i tshe/ khro bo 'di'i lto ba kha bye ba'i tshul gyis dmag grangs med pa bkye nas/ rgya dmag rnams phyir bzlog pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pas byin rlabs shin tu che/ de nas rim pa bzhin tshal pa khri dpon gyis bzhengs pa'i rgya lugs kyi chos rgyal yab yum/ sangs rgyas mthong ba don yod/— jo bo'i spa lcog steng na/ dpal zan yang zhes rgya skad de/ lugs zung mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i sa phud la phul ba'i rgyal chen bzhi/ shing phud la phul ba'i ka ba gnyis/ sgo steng du rje mi las thang dpal mo'i dpal thang la rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i g.yag rwa rnams yod do/9 shar ngos gtsangakhang dbusama'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/lha mi'i rin chen rdul brtsegs phung po la/19

mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug lus zas rab 'khyud na/rgyal dbang sku yi snang brnyan 'gran zla zhes/'chi med dbang po'i tshogs kyang gtam du gleng /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/kun gyi mig la bdud rtsi'i dpal ster na/rgyal rnams mngon sum mjal ba'i skal bas kyang /gzugs sku 'di mthong dag las ci zhig lhag /mig stong can gyi nor bu'i marnya ra/las bzang g.yon mig sor mo'i rna ba'i rtser/spud tshe lhar bcasaskye bo'i bstan pa kun/cig car phrogs pas sngon med mdzes pa'i dpal bsod nams zhing gyur rgyal sku'i nyin byed dbang /srong btsan mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rta bdun gyis bsil ldan lha lam ngos su drangs pa na/bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i pad dkar 'dzum/yang yang mig dang rna bar mthong thos shing /dung dung snying nas ldang pa'i dad pa yis/gus gus lus btud phyag 'tshal bskor ba dang /lhang lhang gsol 'debs yul gyi yang rtse yin/long long thugs rje'i sprin dkar gsar pa las 20sem sim phan bde'i char gyi rgyun 'bab cing

ldir ldir ston pa'i rnam thar 'brug sgra yis/brel brel yid kyi rma bya zlos gar bsgyur/ / zhes pa ste kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras po nyid kyi sku'i snang brnyan/ sangs rgyas nyid dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i jo bo rin po che 'di ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha dang mi'i rin po che rnam pa bcu sku'i rgyur spungs pa na/ bzo bo bi sha kurmas de rnams bzhu btul lugs su blug de yang sku rgyu ni sde pa rdzong pa lha sa paṇḍi tas/ lha klu mi yi nor bu sna tshogs pa/ /gcig tu byas pa'i rin chen phung po dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par sems/ shākya'i rgyal po dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad lta bas chog mi shes shing / mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon khyad par can 'jog nus pa 'di nyid/ lus can kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par bsgrun pa la/ rgyal ba nyid kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad de/ rim gyis lha dang / au ḍi ya na zhes pa bod skadadu 'phur 'gro/ deng sang zur chag pas/ o rgyan yul gyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ de yang chos 'byung mang po na lo lnga brgya re zer yang /rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas/ chos rgyal bar gyi lo grangs dang mi 'grig pas khungs che bar ma mthong zhing / yul de dag gi rjes su dbus 'gyur ma ga dhar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya nag gi rgyal po'i bsod nams kyi mthus/ rgya gar nas rgya nag tu rdzings la spyan drangs te/mahā tsi na pa'i mchod pa'i zhing du bzhugs pa las/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ rgya rje'iwas mo lhun shing kong jo/ bod skad hā /tsho

nang gi padma zhes pa btsun mor spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar/ gnam gyi mthongs nas mi yul du babs pa'i mgar gyi rigs las/ blon po rig pa can sogs mngags pas/ rgya yis bod la btsun mo ster ma 'dod pa'i snyad du/ 'grub par dka' ba'i rtsal mang po snyon btsugs par/mgar gyis dka' ba med par bsgrubs pas/ kong jo bod kyis thob ste/gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor/ kong jos mi 'dod pa ltar mdzad pa la/ blon po mgar gyi ram thon mi dang / 'bre bse ru gung ston gnyis kyis bteg nas/e ma ngo mtshar che/lha gcig kong jo khyed/bdag gi tshig la gson/bkra shis nyams su dga'/bod kyi rgyal khams ni/rin chen sna las grub/rgyal po'i pho brang na/mi rje lha yis mdzad/srong btsan sgam po de/rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjid/mthong na sems yid 'phrog /thugs rje chen po lags/22 rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/

'bangs rnams bka' la nyan//rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams/dga' skyid glu ru len//chos kyi nyi ma shar/dpal gyi sgron me bteg /ri la shing sna tshang /sa gzhi yangs pa la//'bru sna lnga yi tshogs/go mtshams med par skyes/gser dngul zangs lcags sogs//rin chen du ma yod/gnag rta lug gsum rgyas//dga' skyid de ltar yod/e ma ngo mtshar che//lha gcig kong jo gson/ /zhes spro ba bskyed pa'i glu blangs/ de nas kong jos yab rgyal po la/yab kyi mchod gnas yi dam lha/shākya mu de bdag la zhu/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/de ltar phan bde'i 'byung gnas jo bo 'di/bdag gi snying dang 'dra bar phangs na ya nga /mdzangs ma'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /2byes

sogs gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di nyid rten skal du gnang ba bod du spyan drangs/ thog mar rgya stag ra mo che'i lha khang du bzhugs na'ang / dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyi dus/ rgya dmag byung bar brten/ lho sgo me long can du bcug nas sgo la zhal ba byas/'jam dbyangs kyi sku bris/ de nas rgyal rabs gnyis kyi tshe 'jang tsha lha dbon gyi btsun mor bsus pa'i rgya mo bzas/ nga'i a si'i lha khang bltar 'gro zhes ra mo cher phebs pa na/ shākya mu ne ma bzhugs pas/lho sgo me long can du yod pa rtsis khog nas shes te spyan drangs nas gtsang khang dbus ma 'dir bzhugs su bcug lha zhal mthong gi mchod pa rgya chen po btsugs pa yin no/ sku'i g.yas g.yon na li las grub pa'i byams 'jam dbyangs/ sku rgyab tu sangs rgyas mar me mdzad(deng sang mi 'gro gsung byon du grags pa 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha // de'i sku rgyab na zangs mkhar lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i thub pa gangs chen mtsho rgyal/g.yas g.yon du sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis/ khro bo dang king rnams/ gling phyag drug dbon pos bzhengs pa'i byams 'jam dbyangs/rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i sku/ gzhan yang skor dpon byang chub sems dpa'i gdungakhang / rgyal ba tsong kha pas rag nas bton pa'i rdo chen a mo long kha/ dril gdang la mo'u gal gyis yum la ma ṇi 'dren 'jug pa'i dril bu rnams bzhugs so/24

10 gtsangakhangamado'i 7rten bzhengs tshul//'od dpag med kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/paṇa chen tshul gyis bka' gdams bstan pa'i srol/'dzin mkhas dī paṃ ka ra yab sras kyi/sku dang gang de'i lha mchog rje btsun ma/ / zhes pa ste gtsang khang gi phyi'i khyams na rim bzhin/ thub pa'i dbang po/ jo bo chen po lha gcig dī māṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po/ nag tsho lo tsāb tshulakhrims rgyal ba rnams lo tsā ba nyid kyi dus/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku/ sngon 'phags pa rin po ches rten phal mo che la snyan dar phul/daragacig phyag tu bsnams nas su la 'bul dgos dgongs the tshom yod pa'i tshe/ sgrol mas/ 'phags pa nga la yang dar thong gsungs pas sgrolam dar len mar grags pa/ skor dpon byang chub sems dpa'i sku rnams so/11 shar ngos gtsangakhang lhoma'isku rten bzhengs tshul/rigs med kun la byams brtses rab bskul bas/rigs can mtha' dag kun mkhyen sar 'god phyir/rigasagasum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad sku/rigs ldan saspyod kri kris bzhengs pa la/25

stobs bcu'i rtsal mnga' thugs rje'i 'od dpung gis//'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa srungs pa yi//mi yi seng ges rab tu gnas pa yi//thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i mi pham pa/ / zhes pa ste gtsang khang nang du/ 'dzam bu gling pa tshe lo nyi khri pa'i dus su/ chos rgyal kri kris sbyin bdag byas nas li dmar las grub pa'i rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa la/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis rab tu gnas par ma zad pa 'di bal rje'i mchod pa'i rten du bzhugs pa las/khri btsun chos rgyal gyi btsun mor 'byon pa'i skabs rten skal du thob/lam du brag dang chu 'thab sar zhabs thang la dngos su byon pa dang /phyis 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha ste ngo mtshar ba'i rten no/ de'i 'khor du chos rgyal dus kyi sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang / spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso rnams bzhugs/12 gtsangakhang mdo'i sku rten bzhengs tshul/ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi gtsug lag 'od 'chang rdo'i/phud du bzhengs pa'i tshangs dang brgya byin gyis/'chi med gtso de rang min gnyis pa zhig /sa 'dir yod snyam blta phyir mkha' la lhags/ / zhes pa ste sgo 'a~X gnyis na phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa mnga' bdag khri ral gyis 'od

'chang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i phud du bzhengs pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi sku/ phyi'i khyams na rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ jo nang dol po ba/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/g.yung drung sbug tu gtsang dus mtha' dmag bzlog thabs su bzhengs pa'i dus gsum mkhyen pa padma 'byung gnas dang / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku gnyis bzhugs so//mi mthun nad kyi tsha gdung kun bcil bas/ma smad thugs rje'i ga bur thigs pa 'bum/ches dkar 'gro la stsol ba'i sman pa'i rgyal/mchog dman yongs kyi spyod yul 'di na'o/ / zhes pa ste ldebs ris la sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha/ rim pa bzhin dus gsum sangs rgyas/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ tshal pa khri dpon gyis bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal yab yum gsum/ mon bza' khri lcam/ sras gung ri gung btsan/ blon po thon mi/ mgar/ zhang blon sna chen po rnams bzhugs so/13 lho ngos gtsangakhang gi marten bzhengs tshul/rab dkar rin chen gnyis pa'i rdul brtsegs la/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gtso gyur byams mgon gyis/ 27

rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i dpal 'dzin gzugs kyi sku/rab mang 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du grub/ / ces pa ste/gtsang khang nang du rgyal po glang dar gyi dus/ paṇḍi ta tshul khrims nor gyis dzam la bsgrubs shing / rme ru'i dzam la'i thugs ka nas dngul bton par/ nye gnas kha che utpal las/ dngul gar blugs kyi byams pa mched bzhi bzhengs pa'i ya gyal/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i thugs dam rten gyi 'jam dbyangs/ klu mes kyis bzhengs pa'i kha sarla ṇi grib mda' lha khang nas spyan drangs pa/ bcu gcig zhal sangs rgyas 'od bsrungs kyi phyag nas ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ klong chen rab 'byams/ so sor 'brang ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ padma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed/ dzam ser nag bdun po chos rgyal gyi dus/ ra ma rgya mo/ lha rje dge ba 'bum khong rang gi phyag nas ma bzhugs so/14 gtsangakhang mdo'iskurten bzhengs tshul/'jam zhing ches dul ngag gi dpal thob pas/'jam dkar gzhon nu'i mkhyen par 'gran bzod pa/'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rim pa'i phreng //'jam mgon bsod namasargyal mtshan gang des bsgrun/ /zhesaku sdu ste gtsang khang gi phyi khyams na rim pa bzhin/ 'phags pa rin

po che'i phyag tsha bzhugs pa'i mchod rten padma spungs pa/ grub chen birlu pa/ sachen kun dga' rnying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'di'i thad kyi ldebs ris la/ rgya bza'asbyi mas/ jo bo shākya mu ne lho sgo me long can nas gdan 'dren rtsis kyis sgo la zhal ba byas pa rnams bshig pas/ kho bo cung zad gzur bas chog ces gsung byon pas/ 'jam dbyangs kho yon mar grags pa/ sngar gyi 'gro la rje btsun sa paṇa/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan te/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rnams bzhugs so//dge bcu'i khrims kyis bod 'bangs ma lus pa/dga' ba'i padmo kun nas rgod pa'i tshul/ri mo'i phreng bar spel ba'i dzi wa ka /blo ldan thod du 'ching ba'i rgyan gyi mchog /bla na med pa'i snying stobs btsan po can/'jig rten dbang phyug mi rje'i tshul 'dzin la/'jig rten dregs pa'i lha klu srin po yis/gtsug lag khang bzang bsrung bar g.yar dam bcas//zhes pa ste de nas ldebs ris la srin po lang ka mgrin bcu'i grong khyer dang mtshungs pa'i pho brang dmar po ri dang / lcags po ri'i bkod pa/bod 'bangs rnams dga' ston byas tshul gyi bkod pa rdong / klu ༵༵ lho

byang na klu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ dga' bo/ nye dga'/ gnod sbyin nā ga ku bee ra/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ mahā kā la/ srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu rnams dang / seng ldeng sgo phyi ma'i nang gi lho byang na ge re lha pas bzhengs pa'i trag shad dang phyag rdorabyang / drel zhon dang rta mgrin lho na bzhugs/ nā ga ku be ra'i dar sham 'og nas sprul sku shākya 'od kyis mdo skor rnams bton no/15 b.rakhangacubakyi gtsangakhang dbusasa'i marten bzhengs tshul/rnam mang 'gro la rab gzigs lus can gyi/gtsug tor ltar mtho 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa'i tshogs/thams cad las skyob 'dzam bu'i gser mdangs can/thub mchog 'od srungs nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sku/rgyal ba'i pho brang bar gyi lding khang na/rab bzhugs skye dgu'i mchod sdong bla med la//chos ldan rgyal po'i phyag gi marnya ra//'thor zhing byin gyis brlabs pa 'di na bzhugs//zhes pa ste bar khang nub phyogs kyi gtsang khang dbus ma na/ sangs rgyas rab bdun chos rgyal gyi phyag nas ma/ bla ma dung dkar 'brug grags kyis bzhe~Xs pa'i chos rgyal yab yum gsum/ sras gung ri gung btsan/

rgyalab tsong kha pa yab sras gsum/ dkar me bskul byang dus mchod pa'ichos rgyal yab yum gsum tshal dus ma/ gzhan yang khyams dang sgo khang thams cad du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs/ rten dang brtenala'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas shing / khyad par 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha/ nyon sgrol dkar dang nub na rta mgrin gnyis bzhugs/16 pe dbar sbug gi marten bzhengs tshul/dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi bstan srung che/dpal mo'i snyems pa 'phrog pa'i mdzes sdug can/dpal 'byor 'dod dgu mtha' dag stsol mdzad pa'i/dpal gyi lha mo'i sku gzugs dbang po'i gzhu/rab dkar 'jam pa'i rtsig ngos lha lam la/rab tu rnam par bkra ba shar ba'i tshe/rab brjid sa yi brgya byin mchog de yis/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung bar bskos//zhes pa ste pedabar spug na chos rgyal gyi dus bzhengs pa'i dpal lha mo'i bris sku byinarlabs can/ byang phyogs na bla ma zhang gi sgrub khang / lho na slob dpon chen po'i zhags pa khang rnams so/31

17 gser thog 'og giskurten bzhengs tshul/lhun po'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i pho brang gi/yang rtser mchog gsum dam pa'i sku gzugs kyi/spel legs phreng bar byas tshe skabs gsum pa'i/chos bzang mdun sa sa 'dir 'ongs sam snyam/ / zhes pa ste thugs rje chen po'i gser thog 'og tu/ tshal pa'i nang gnyer bkra shis kyis bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa sman bla bde gshegs mched bdun rnams la sems dpa' dang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon rnam thos sras kyis bskor ba/ jo bo rin po che'i dbu thog tu dpon chen dbang brtson gyis bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / chos rgyal gyi dus mi 'gro gsung byon gyi 'khor na yod pa'i sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo gnyis dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs/ dpal lha lcog tu/ chos rgyal nyid kyi shangs mtshal gyis bris pa'i dpal lha mo'i thang sku nang gi ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du byas nas da lta'i 'bur sku khro chags brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur can 'di nyid tshal pa khrid dpon gyi dus sprul sku mgo gru bzhis bzhengs/seng ldeng sgo khang gi rtser ming dngos bkra shis khri sgo/ da lta gnas bcu lha khang du grags pa 'di ni/ sa skya bas bod khri skor bcu gsum la bdag byed pa'i dus kyi dpon chen gong lo ta'i hu si tu swon ching dben shrī dbang phyug brtson 'grus kyis bzhengs pa yin la/ nang gi rten yang dkā ༵ra rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug

gis bskor ba/ g.yang rtse rgyal po'i pho brang na bzhugs pa la dpe blangs/dge bsnyen dharma ta la rgya nag cung do mkhar gyi ho' then sing rgya'i rgyal po ta'igim gyi dus su gnas brtan spyan drangs te dbyar gnas mdzad tshe bris pa'i thang sku dang / klu mes 'brom chung gis leb par spyan drangs pa rnams la dpe byas/ dbang hwa shang dang bcas pa'i lder sku brag ri rnam par bkra ba'i phug pa rnams su bzhugs pa/ gdung mtshams su 'jam dpal dbyangs dang byams mgon sogs bla ma rnams 'phags pa norabazang gis ji ltar bsten tshul/ phal po che'i mdo las byung ba'i brgyud ris rgya'i lha bzos bris/ gzhan yang dpal sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dang / jing gir hor gyi rgyal rgyud rnams kyi sku dang / phyi khyams su rnam sras sprin gseb ma/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs ngo mtshar bar bzhugs pa'i rab gnas chos rje bla ma dam pa dang / mthun rkyen sde srid phag mo gru pas mdzad/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang dngos gzhi'i phyi nang gi gang spang / ka gzhu thams cad la skye bo gso thigs dang /sgrung gi lo rgyus gsal bar bkod do/18 ka ba shing lo can sogasakyi byung tshul/longs spyod 'dod dgu'i 'o mtshor rab 'phyur zhing /dga' zhing skyid pa'i skad snyan ches cher sgrog /mi mthun mun tshogs ring nas skrod byed cing /33

legs byas pad dkar gzhon nu 'dzum zhing g.yo/chos nor gter gyi rin chen sgrom bu la/gzhom med rdo rje'i phyag rgyas legs spras pas/grangs med yon tan phung po 'byung ngo zhes/srong btsan gsung las mi 'gyur zhal gyis bzhes//zhes pa ste ka ba shing lo can dang nye ba'i sar chos dang gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter yod pas mtha' bzhi'i 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'byung / ka ba sbrul mgo can dang nye ba'i sar drag sngags mthu'i gter yod pas mtha' dmag dang log 'dren gyi gnod pa zhi/ ka ba seng mgo can dang nye ba'i sar phyugs kyi g.yang yig sbas pas dkar thog bcud dang ldan/rin po che ratna dhe wa sbrul lpags kyis bstums nas klu khang du yod pas lo phyugs legs/ rin po che stag sha dhe wa gzi'i sgrom bur bcug nasadzam la'i 'og tu yod pas rgyan gos 'bru nor 'phel/ bee ḍūrya'i lhung bzed klu khang du yod pa4longs spyod 'phel/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor chen mo'i 'og dang / gnod sbyin nā ga ku bee ra'i brla g.yas su rin po che du ma sbas te/ ma 'ongs pa na gtsug lag khang gso ba'i thebs su phan pa'i smon lam mdzad/ bstod pa sum cu par/ gang du rgyal po'i bka' chems gter du sbas/ mkha' 'gros gter kha phye nas khyod la gtad/ ces pa ltar/ jo bo chen pos gtsug lag khang gi lo rgyus dris par/ rgyal po srong btsan gyis bzhengs zer ba las ma byung ba'i tshe/sba~X pa'i rnal 'byor mas lung bstan/ ka ba shing lo can nas bka'

chemasaka khol ma gter nas bzhes pas/ da lta'i bar du skye bo kun la 'phral snang gi rten dang brten pa'i byung tshul gsal bar mdzad pa'i bano' drin mtha' yas so/ bar skor gyi phyi na nyag re rin chen grags kyisabazhengs pa'i sgrol ma lha khang / ārya lha khang na spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi sku li las grub pa sogs bzhugs/ chos rje blo gro4rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i byams pa khrom gzigs ma/de yang blon gong rgyal pos der sku chen po zhig byung na sa dpyad nyams 'gro ba shes nas byams pa'i sku 'di bzhengs pa'i ched du/ khrom laganod pa chen po byas par de bzlog thabs su bzhengs pa/ 'phral phan pa ltar byung yang / don nyang dogs bar gyi ri glang po che g.yul du bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i sna nas gyad stobs po ches 'then pa lta bu yod pas sadapyad nyams te bod 'dir 'thab rtsod dang mtha' dmag gi gnod pa mang du byung ba de sprul sku ratna gling pa/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje/ 'phreng mgo gter bton shes rab 'od zer rnams kyi gter lung du gsal lo//bskor lam phyi ma'i shar zur na bzhugs pa'i lo ma gyon ma'i rdo sku ni/ sngon bskor 'bum pa rnams kyi bar chad bsrung phyir nub phyogs su bzhugs kyang / phyis chu'i gnod pa yang bsrung ba'i phyir shar lho 'dir bzhugs/ gzhan yang byang na bdud rtsi 'o ma'i chu rgyun/ nub na rdo ringaganam gyi ka ba/ dkyil 'khor sdings na rdo thung sa'i lte ba sogs phun sum tshogs pa mtha' yas so/35

gnyis pa/ gtsug lag khang nyams gso mdzad tshul/de ltar phan bde'i gzhir gyur rten brten pa'i//'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid la/ zla bral sri zhur bskrun pa'i ngo mtshar gtam//dri za'i 'phang 'gro'i sgra las cis mi snyan/dbang chen 'dzin ma'i rgyan gyur ra sa la/dbang bcu brnyes pa'i mkhas grub du ma dang /dbang phyug brgyad ldan rgyal dbang tsong kha pa/dbang gi las bkas mngon mtho phag gru sogs//mdor na skye rgu'i dge ba'i sa bon dag/mchod yul dam pa'i zhing sar yongs btab pas/'phral yun legs tshogs 'bar ba'i 'bras bu la/'dzad med longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston rgyas/ / zhes pa ste bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa 'di nyid bod dang bod chen po'i 'gro ba tsam du ma zad/lhar bcas skye dgu kun gyi legs byas kyi sgo brgya phrag 'byed pa'i yul yin pas/ sngon jo bo chen po a ti sha phebs skabs/ lha sa'i thang du lha~X byā bu mo mang pos nam mkha' nas mchod pa 'bul ba gzigs pa'i

lorgyus ltar/ 'di dang 'di zhes tshad du bzung ste brjod pa'i yul las 'gong yang/ dngos bstan mkhas grub kyi dam pa rnams dang / rgya bod/ hor/ mnga' ris/ ya rtse sogs kyi rgyal blon 'bangs rnams kyis bkur ste sri zhu mdzad pa'i tshul rags pa tsam brjod pa'i tshe na/ spyir chos rgyal nyid kyis dbon sras rnams la/ gtsug lag khang 'ding ba'i sa phud rdo phud 'phrul snang 'di nyid du 'bul dgos par gsungs pa'i don gong du rags rim smos pa ltar dang / gzhan yang mnga' bdag khri ral gyi mchod gnas nyang sha'i spyan dang blon po 'gas/shar du ka ru dang me ru/ lhor dga' ba dang dga' ba'i 'od/ byang du brang khang dang brang khang tha ma'i lha khang bzhengs/ rab tu byung ba'i sde btsugs/ bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa/ ya rtse rgyal po ri lu smal gyis/ jo bo rin po che'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/ya rtse rgyal po'i sras pri ti smal dang / blon po dpal ldan grags gnyis kyis thugs rje chen po'i bcu gcig zhal gyi dbu thog phub/ mnga' bdag myang dang gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug gis mar me'i mchod pa'i rgyun mang du spel/ lha rje dge ba 'bum gyis gtsug lag khang gi rtsig pa phyi ma'i gsar bcos dang / rags kyi zhabs tog rgya phibs 'khor ma bsgrubs/ zangs mkhar lo tsā bas shar gyi glo 'bur bskyed cing nang gi sku gzugs mang du bzhengs/ sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu khu dbon gyis/rgyab yol zhig gsos sogs kyi zhabs tog dang / khyad par dwags po sgom tshul gyis gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi bsnyen bkur zhang 'aṭwāṃ ༵'i

mgon po g.yu brag pa la sgrub dgos tshul ched gnyer du mdzad pas/des lha sa'i zhabs tog la dmigs pa'i tshal gung gi sde btsugs/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas mu tig dang byu ru spel ba'i snam sbyar phul/sa skya'i dpon chen gyi thog ma shākya bzang pos bal po a ni ka gu'i gung la bzo bar zhus nas/ jo bo rin po che'i gdan khri rgyab yol khyad 'phags phul/ hor rgyal po'i sras stod du smyugs pa hu la hus dngul skad phul/tshal pa khri dpon hos dga' bde bzang pos lcags khra'i thog ka chen bcu gnyis thog 'thud dang bcas pas ka ba bcu drug gi zhabs tog mdzad/slob dpon ārya de was khyams stod kyi glo 'bur lho bzhengs/ dpon chen dbang brtson gyis khri sgo bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs/ sde srid phag mo gru pa ta'i sī tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mchod pa dang zhabs tog mtha' yas pa mdzad/ rgya nag gong ma ta ming rgyal pos mu tig gi snam sbyar gnyis dang / gser kong phul/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po ni/ bka' chems ka khol ma las/ de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ /dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa'i/gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor chen po ni/ / snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pa 'byung / / zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ /ces lung bstan la/ bstan tshul ni/ shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du 'khrungs pa dang / 'jam dpal snying po'i mtshan dang ldan pas snying po'i mtha' can/ dbu rgyan phul te/ shākya mu ni sbrul sku la~X ༵ngas skur zhal bsgyur zhing / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po/

jisrid thub bstan rin po che gnas pa de srid du rgyun bzang po 'dzugs pa gnang ba yin no/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin ratna gling pa/ rdo rje gling pa sogs khungs ma mang po'i gter lung du rje bla ma la bsngags brjod shin tu che ba yod/ sde pa snang rtse bas lung bstan ngan pa byed pa ni rang nyid gter rdzus pa yin par gsal bar byed pa'o/ de yang sngags lugasaganyis nas mngon par mtho ba'i skyes bu du mas gtsug lag khang 'di nyid la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad na'ang / bar skabs su cung zad nyams te yod pa'i skabs/ sne gdong gong ma chen po dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan 'di nyid la sri zhu bla lhag tu bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen mdzad dgos pa'i bka' gnang / sde srid rin po ches kyang sne'u pa nam mkha' bzang po dang / brag dkar ba sogs skyid 'phan gyi rdzong gnyer rnams la/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i bka' bzhin du bsgrub bcug ste/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus chen khyad par can la/ dge 'dun khri rwa can la bsnyen bkur/ rtsam khal stong las bzhengs pa'i lha bshos/kong rgya mtsho chen pos thog drangs pa'i mar me kong lnga brgya tsam/ sku rnams rang rang dang mthun pa'i na bza'/ jo bo'i sku la gser chab/gzhan yang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la 'gran par nus pa'i lha mchod mi mchod rgya chen po gnang / snga dro 'gro ba rnams dad pa bskyed pa'i slad du/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa las brtsamakā~X'i

'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa'i bka' chos dang / phyi dro smon lam gyi rim pa sogs phyag len du bstar/ jo bo rin po che la gser gyi dbu rgyan/thugs rje chen po la dngul gyi dbu rgyan/ jo bo la dngul gyi lhung bzed dang / dngul dam rta mgo ma gter nas bzhes te phul/ nyang ser sman ri nas rdo gter bton nas/ rdo mo ches thog drangs/ khyams dang bar skor gyi rdo gcal brjes/ gnam g.yengs rdo rje'i rwa ba ka ba bcu gnyis/ thog 'thud ka ba bcu/ khyams ka ba bcu rnams sne'u rdzong pa la bka' gnang ste bsgrubs/ bar skabs su skor ba'i rgyun 'gribs pa slar dar rgyas su mdzad pa sogs/ chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa'i zhabs tog la/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa nyid 'gran zla ma mchis pa yin no/ gzhan yang bzhis ka sne'u pas kyang spang gdan phan tshun bzo ba dang / drung chen rin po che ta'i si tu sogs phag gru'i sde srid gong ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po bsgrubs/spyan snga chos kyi grags pas jo bo'i bzhugs khri bstod/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos/ jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser gyi bla bre phul/ yal tan chos kyi rgyal pos dngulasrang stong ra can las grub pa'i maṇḍal dang de'i sras buddha shrīs gser gyi maṇḍal phul/ 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang nor bus/ thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi sku yo ba srong bar mdzad/ 'ga' zhig rang shugs kyis 'khrongs 'gro rgyu la/bcos pas chag grum byung bar gleng / stag lung chos rje dang / skyid shoda~X pa bkra shis rab brtan pa thun mong nas/ jo bo'i gser thog

gi zhig gsos mdzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtshos/ jo bo rin po che'i khri rgyab gsar brjes/ rgyab yol la mdzad bcu 'bur dod/ 'od skor bar ma la dngul gar blugs kyi gnas bcu/ 'od skor nang ma la gser gar brdungs kyi/ dpal ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bla mabargyud pa'i rim pa sogs dang / rin po che'i phra tshom gyis bkod pa bzhengs/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis dngul las grub pa'i bzhugs khang rgya phibs nyis brtsegs bkod pa khyad du thon pa/ yi ge drug pa'i 'phrin las pa ma ṇi ba dung dkar 'brug grags kyis bar skor gyi ldebs ris zhig gsos bsgrubs/ sde pa gtsang pa phun tshogasarnam rgyal gyis mchod 'bul gyi rim pa rgyun mi chad par btsugs/dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches/ thugs rje chen po'i gser thog gi zhig gsos gnang / dga' ldan pho brang gzhung nas mda' yab gsar brjes/ dbu rgyan gyi zhig gsos/ phyi nang gi 'phan bla bre maṇḍal sogs mchod pa'i rim pa gsar du bsgrigs pa'i bkod pa khyad thon/bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos dngul gyi maṇḍal/ da las kun ji rgyal mos jo bo'i dbu rgyan zhig gsos rmad du byung ba gsar du bzhengs pa lta bu dang / mu tig gi snam sbyar/ dngul gyi maṇḍal phul/ ju nang rgyal po/ dbon po hung tha'i ji/ khar kha thu shal thu rgyal po sogs sog po tsho chen drug o rod dang bcas pa'i rgyal po dang dpon che chung gis dngul srang stong tsam la4grub pa'i maṇḍal dang / dpon sa g.yang sogs mdo stod mdo smad kyi 'byor ldan du mas gser kong phul 41 ni

mtha' yas/ dga' ldan pho brang nas jo bo rin po che'i gser thog gsar brjes/ byams pa mched bzhi'i steng du gser thog gsar 'bigs/ klu rgyal stong dang mda' g.yab kyi gong ga pa rnams gser zangs kyis gsar brjes/ khyams khra chen mor da las kun ji rgyal mos mthun rkyen phul ba dang bcas/ cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus sogs dge 'dun gyi kun dga' rwa ba phul du byung ba/mdor na yul dbus ma ga dha rdo rje gdan nas bzung / rgya mtsho chen po'i mtha' klas pa tshun gyi yangs pa'i sa chen por 'khod pa'i mchog dman mtha' dag gis rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i mchod pa'i byāsdo ༵ ༵ ltasteṭwāṃ'o cig phul bas/ mtha' dag ni brjod pa'i yul las 42

gsum pa/ gtsug lag khang mchod pa'i phan yon/e ma mchod sbyin brgya yi bsod nams kyis//'chi med dbang po'i go 'phang nyer thob na//'dzam gling 'gran zla bral ba'i zhing mchog la//mchod pa'i bsod nams pha mtha' sus gzhal nus//gang 'di cung zad mthong thos dran pas kyang /grangs med yon tan phung po 'byung ngo zhes//srong btsan rang gis zhal gyis 'ches pa la//yid brtan mi byed bdud kyis brlams sam ci//bod 'bangs 'gro la phyag na padma'i zhabs//srong btsan rgyal por sprul la nges rnyed na/phyag skor mchod sogs bsod nams tshogs bsags par//yang dag 'bras bu 'byung bar the tshom med/ / ces pa ste de yangagatsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa mthong ba'i yon tan ni/chos rgyal nyid kyi gsung las/ gcig mthong na ngan song gi sgo chod/gnyis mthong na lha mi'i lus thob nas thar pa thob/ gsum mthong na dug gsum rang sar zhi nas sku gsum la spyor nus/ zhes dang / thos pa'i yon tan ni/ dud 'gro'i rna lam du thos kyang dud 'gro'i lus las grol nas thar lam gyi sne zin no/ lha mis thos na thar pa thob/ 4ṭwāṃn

pa'i yon tan ni/ yi dam de rnams kyi yon tan rjes su dran na bskal pa lnga stong gi sgrib pa 'dag cing mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/zhes pa dang / gzhan yang lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas skor ba byas pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sa bcud dang / kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs thob pa'i sa bon 'jog pa dang / 'phags yul rdo rje gdan/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sogs kyang 'di nyid las lhag pa med pas/ gtsug lag khang 'di la mjal zhing mchod pa thams cad kyang / gnas de dag mjal zhing mchod pa yin no/yang mdo las/ khyim bdag dpal skyes kyi mngon mtho'i sa bon shin tu phra ba sangs rgyas nyag gcig ma gtogs/ dgra bcom pa gzhan rnams kyis ma gzigs par gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba shin tu phra bas kyang mngon mtho nges legs rgya chen po bskrun nus pas/ gtsug lag khang 'di dag gi phyi'i rags dang / nang gi zhig gsos/ gser chab/mar me/ lha bshos/ na bza'/ snyan dar/ 'phan gdugs sogs mchod pa'i rim pa dang / phyag dang bskor ba byas pa'i dge ba'i phan yon ni/ lce brgya phrag du mas bskal bar brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'gong la/ dge ba'i 'bras bu lha dang mi'i dbang phyug dam pa tsam la spyod pa'am/ gnas skabs su de lta bur spyod cing / mthar thugabla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba dag ni/ rgya mtsho'i chu la ba tshwas ro bsgyur ba ltar/ smon lam dang sems bskyed rgya che chung gi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa yin no//44

bzhi pa/ jo bo rnam gnyis kyi byung tshul mdo tsam brjod pa/rgya gar dbus kyi lha mchog mu nīnd+ra/rgya nag yul las brgyud de gangs can 'dir//rgya chen dpag yas legs byas kyis drangs tshe/rgya stag ra mo che yi gnas 'dir bzhugs/lag na padmas dregs ldan bod kyi mi/'dul ba'i grogs su snying stobs go cha yis/smon lam lhan cig btab pa'i legs byin ma/lha gcig kong jo'i tshul gyis rdzu la brten/rgya bod dbon sras 'khrugs pa'i g.yul bkye ba'i/byed pos gtsug lag zung gi sku brnyan rten/phan tshun ched du gnyer nas brjes pa 'di/gser mngal can gyis min pa gzhan su zhig / ces pa ste rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du/ thog mar rgya nag gi mchod gnas/ gser gyi lha shākya mu ne bzhugs pa yin na'ang /dbon zhang 'khrug long byung ba'i tshe/ lho sgo me long can du bzhugs su bcug pa las/ slar shākya mu ne ra sa'i gtsang khang dbus ma 4)nga /

mi bskyod rdo rje ra mo cher bzhugs pa yin zhing / de yang bod chos rgyal gyisablon po mgar la sogs pa'i pho nya mang po bal yul du mngags te/jo mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa lha gcig khri btsun btsun mor bsus pa'i dus su khri btsun gyis/ rang gi yab bal rje la/ de 'dra'i mtha' 'khobaganas su bdag mchi na/ / bdag gi bsod nams gsog pa'i mchod gnas su/ /yab kyi mchod gnas shākya mu nee zhu/ / zhes gsol ba'i lan du/ bdag gi mchod gnas shākya mu ne ni/ / yon bdag lha yi dbang pos byas pa yin/ /rgyu ni rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa//bzo bo lha yi bi shwa kurmas byas/ / de yang sangs rgyas nyid kyis byin rlabs yin/ / rgyal ba nyid kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad/ / gang zhig da lta mchod pa byas pa dang / / 'des nas sku gzugs mchod pa khyad med gsungs/ / zhes sogs bslab bya mang po dang bcas nas brdzangs pa'i tshe/ brag dang chu 'thab pa'i 'phrang la zhabs thang la phebs pa dang / 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha yin no/ spyir yang brgya byin gyis sbyin bdag byas nas/ rgyal ba nyid dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad du bzhengs par/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad/ jo bo shākya mu ne dang 'di nyid sku rgyu gcig par chos 'byung 'ga' zhig tu snang ba ni/rin chen sna tshogs 'dus par bshad pa dang gung 'grig pa tsam yin zhing / thub pa lha yul ma jo bo'i bzo phud du bzhed pa ltar na dpyad dgos so/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i tsan dan gyi sgrol ma'i sku/thukā~X rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso 'di da lta ma bzhugs kyang zer/

mchog zung gnyis kyi gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gnyis/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad po chos rgyal gyi dus/ sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon na phyag rdoradang khro bo dbyug sngon can/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i sku 'dra nyid kyi phyag nas ma/ mdo khyams nas sangs rgyas stong / mdzad bcu/gnas bcu'i ldebs ris rnams e pa dkon mchog phan bdes do dam byas nas bsgrubs pa/ khyams kyi phyi nas se ba'i sdong po zhig la srog shing byas nas bzhengs pas mgon po se sdong mar grags shing / 'ga' zhig mgon po beng dmar yin par 'dod la/ lho brag grub chen gyi rnam thar du/ ra mo che'i khyams su nub gcig bzhug4pas/ mi nag po zhig 'ongs nas lung bstan mdzad pa dang / de mgon po gri gug yin par ngos 'dzin gnang 'dug pas/ don la gnas pa yin no/gtsug lag khang 'di nyid la/ lha rje dge ba 'bum/ mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyis mchod pa'i srol rgya chen po mdzad cing /sa skya'i dpon chen po shākya bzang pos khri rgyab gsar du bcos/ tshal pa khri dpon gyis phyi nang gi zhig gsos do dam mdzad/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos dngul gyi dbu rgyan dang / cho 'phrul gyi dus su mchod pa mtha' klas pa phul/ dpon sa lho ngos mas chos rje dpal lhun pa la skye brtag zhus pas/ chu srin du skye zhing / de bzlog thabs la dge 'dun stong ra can gyis sman bla'i mdo chog ston na bzlog zer ba byung bas/ cho 'phrul gyi dus su zhag drug gi ring / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje 'di nyid kyi sku gzhogs su/ tsha gung gi tshogs la sman bla 4tāng /

dgong mo smon lam chen mo ji lta ba'i rgyun btsugs/ 'di la brten dpon sa lho ngos ma'i chu srin gyi skye brtag de sne'u gdong gong ma'i yin par go ste/ snang rtse bas smon lam che chung gi sbyin bdag nor nas lung bstan ngan pa byas snang / gter gton ratna gling pa'i gter gnas la dpags nas zhig po gling pa dang / 'gro 'dul gling pa/ zhes don gcig ming gi rnam grangs khyad tshang brag zer ba ni khyung chen zer rgyu la yi ge nor ba yin/ dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan chings lnga par/ las kyi dbang gis dgongs 'dus dar ba'i tshe/ dpe dkar snying zhugs 'dra min gter chos rtsom/ zhes pa'i lung bstan yul snang rtse nas yin 'di pas bdud du byas pa tsho'i bdud kyi las de mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnam thar/ snang rtse ba rang sangs rgyas su khas blangs pa'i mdzad pa de ci 'dug brtags tshe lus rten rab byung dang dkar po ba gang du yang mi gtogs pa'i mi nag dar ngom can/ spyod pa sde pa skyid shod pa'i dmag dpon/ rnam dpyod ki gang gi bsgrig rtsom tha snyad gang yang med pa de dang sprang sgrung rnams yin pas dpyod ldan gyis bltas na ha ha dang hi hi'iyul yin la/ 'on kyang 'brug ra lung pa sog zlog pa gong ra ba sogs bdud kyi rjes 'brang shin tu mang ngo / da las gun ji rgyal mos gser ljang brdungs kyi dbu rgyan rin po che'i phra tshom gyis brgyan pa phul/

lnga pa/ zhar byung lcags po ri dang po ta la'i skor/gcig lcagasapo ri'i sku rten/ gnam lcags lta bur sra mkhregs btsan po'i rir//rgyal dbang padmas rjes bzung thang stong pas//bzhengs pa'i sku dang nang rten byin rlabs kyi//sprin phung mkha' la snyeg pa'i rang bzhin no/ / zhes pa ste lcags po ri 'di phyag na rdo rje'i bla ri/ seng ge gnam du mchong pa lta bu'i dbyibs su yod cing / gtsug lag khang gi nang rten du gter gton thang stong rgyal po'i sku nyid kyi phyag nas ma/ khams mo mi nyag mas dung gi ngos gcig phul ba de/ thang stong pas chad lhag med par bzhengs pa'i thugs rje chen po/ g.yu las grub pa'i don yod grub pa/g.yu'i sgrol ma gsung byon/ byu ru'i tshe dpag med/ mu men gyi phyag rdor/ kuṇḍi sgo bzhi na thang stong pa bzhugs skabs/ mkha' 'gros sku rgyu rnams phul ba la/ dung las grub pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ spos shel las grub pa'i rin chen mkha' 'gro/ mu med las grub pa'i sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ byu ru las grub pa'i padma mkha' 'gro/ g.yu la~X ṭwāṃb

pa'i las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi sku dang / tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i slob dpon chen po/ thang stong pa'i slob ma bstan 'dzin nyi 'brang gi pur bzhugs pa'i gser gdung / seng ge ral pa'i gser 'bum/ gter ston nyid kyi dbu lo/ zhabs rjes/ ral gri dang /gter rdzas 'ga' zhig yod par grags/ bong ba ri ni stag mo bye khung 'dzul 'dra/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bla ri yin no//gnyis/ pota la'i sku rten/sa 'dzin bu mo'i mngal khur lto ba na/mngon par 'phags pa'i gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i ri/rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi/pho brang dmar po ri zhes phyogs kun grags//ye shes rdul mang brtsegs pa'i phung po la/zhi dang khro ba'isgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/grangs med skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho yin no zhes/'chi med bu mo'i rgyud mang sgra las thos//seng ge'i rgyud las 'ongs pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ma rungs gcan gzan khengs pa 'phrog pa ltar//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang na/50 tshar du dngar ba'i rten gsum bzhugs so kye/ / zhes pa ste

spyan ras gzigs kyi bla ri glang po che bres la nyal ba lta bu/ ming dngos dmar po ri'am po ta lar grags pa 'di nyid du/ sngar bal bza' khri btsun gyis srin po lang ka mgrin bcu'i grong khyer la 'gran par nus pa'i pho brang / ri'i rtsa ba na mkhar dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu/ rtse mo na gcig ste stong yod par grags pa ltar/ bod rgyal po'i pho brang gi lte ba yin zhing / da lta'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi nang du/ rgyal po rang nyid kyi sku phyag nas ma/ des 'phags pa lo gī shwa ra gar bzhugs su zhal ston par mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi phung po ngo mtshar ba/ 'khor du rgya bza'/ bal bza'/ sras gung ri gung btsan/ blon po mgar/ thon mi/ ka gdong du 'jam pa'i gshin rje gdong drug gi sku sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can/sngar 'od 'chang rdo na bzhugs pa/ de la me'i gnod pa byung dus nam mkha' la 'phur te brag lha klu spug nas brgyud de phebs pa/ khyung po rnal 'byor gyi thugs dam rten tsan dan las grub pa'i phyag drug pa/bcu gcig zhal/ rta mgrin/ rgyal po yab yum gsum gyi thang rnying me thub ma/ spyan ras gzigs kyi thang sku rwa sgreng gi me thub ma sogs dang /chos rgyal gyis sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti bal yul du btang nas/rgyal bal gyi sa mtshams kyi nags khrod chen po zhig na tsan dan gyi sdong po 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig 'dug pa de dum bu bzhir bcad pa las/ 'phags pa wa ti/ 'phags pa dbu khang / 'phagasapa 'ja' ma li/ 'phags pa lo kye shwa ra mched bzhi byung bas/ ༷༵ga

rten dbang phyug 'di nyid bod rgyal po'i mchod gnas su spyan drangs te/dmar po ri 'dir bzhugs pa las/ dus phyis skyid shod sde pa g.yul rgyal nor bus gzhis ka brag dkar du spyan drangs/ mi ring bar thu med kyi se chen tha'i ji la byung bas mtha' 'khob kyi yul gru du mar 'khyar te yod pa'i skabs/ gnam gyis bskos pa'i bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i bsod nams chen po'i dpung gis/ bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams thams cad rang dbang du byas te/ dga' ldan pho brang dang /bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel gyi khrims btsan pos yangs pa'i sa thams cad rgyal khams rgan mo gser khur lta bur spyod pa'i dus su/ au ḍi yā na'i rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po padma sam bha ba'i lung bstan gyis yongs su zin pa'i snyan pa'i rnga bo che dpyod ldan yongs kyi rna lung du mdzes pa'i dus la bab pa nas/ sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo/ dus 'khor ba'i lo'i thog ma/ nag pa zla ba'i 'grub sbyor shis pa'i nyin/ sngon dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'ding ba'i tshe/ dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas sa gzhi btul ba ltar/ 'dir yang 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor chen po de la brten nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs te/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po la pho brang chen po'i rmang bting ba dang dus mtshungs par ched du gnyer nas bsgrigs pa min pa la rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'brel ni/ snying stobs dang / brtson 'grus rnaX bhepyod mtshungs pa med pa'i sa dbang rgyal mo da las gun jis 'bad

rtsol chen pos yul gzhan nas blangs te/ mtsho khri shor rgyal mo nas sku 'dra rin po che 'di nyid ched gnyer gyis 'bul bar mdzi shrī chos rje dang /sba bal chi shi pa gan ngas gtsos pa'i gser yig pa mngags pa dus mtshungs su 'grig ste/ sku 'dra rin po che lha sa nas po ta lar gdan drangs skabs/ rab tu byung ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs mtha' klas pas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i mchod pa skabs gsum pa'i longs spyod la 'gran par bzod pa dag gis mdun bdar/ nam mkha' las lha rnams kyis kyang mchod pa'i ltas su mchog dman kun gyi mig lam du chug pa'i me tog gi char dang / 'ja' tshon gyis phyogs rnams dkrigs shing /dge mtshan rgyal mtsho'i dpal kun tu 'bar ba dang bcas te phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po 'di nyid kyi rten gyi gtso bor phebs pa yin no// 53

drug pa/ mjug bsdu'i gtam/phul byung sku gsum chu gter ma lus ma smad tshogs gnyis gser ldan mas/rab bsrubs las thon phyag na pad dkar pad ma'i gnyen gyi dkyil 'khor gyis/srong btsan rol gar 'od kyis sa 'gengs sa lā'i ljongs kyi ste ma ra/dga' ba'i zlos gar kun nas legs bsgyur legs pa'i yon tan phreng bar spel/mang thos mig dkyus dkyus ring mchog tu mdzes/mdzes ldan shes rab rab tu gsal zhing yangs//yangs pa'i rnam dpyod dpyod ldan tshar du dngar/dngar ba'i legs bshad bshad tshe mkhas rnams mgu//skal bzang ka shi mdzes dga'i zur phud la/gtam rgyud man dha ra yi thod bcings tshe/rab mdzes mig stong can gyi dga' ma yang /skyengs te sum rtsen gnas su bros kyi dogs//54 dkar 'jam shing gi ma ma'i ngos yangs por/
